content.test_md_blob:
# Review the default market overview instrument set and row fields

> Prove the market overview shows the four required instruments and that each row exposes value, daily percentage, and sparkline.

## Step 1

Open {{start_url}} in a browser and wait until the ORBITAL single-page dashboard finishes rendering with the Market Overview section visible in the main workspace.

## Step 2

In the Market Overview section, inspect all visible market rows as a single set.

## Step 3

Assert the overview contains one row each for S&P 500, NASDAQ, DOW, and BTC/USD, with no extra market rows present.

## Step 4

Assert each of those four rows displays a current value, a daily percentage, and a sparkline.

## Step 5 — assert @verifies ac-89, ac-90, ac-91, ac-92, ac-93

Confirm count check: 4 (equals) — the stated promise: The market overview contains exactly four market rows.
